key_insight: EAPO improves LLM reasoning by reusing prior RL experience in a policy-adaptive way, injecting it only at critical decisions instead of replaying fixed trajectories.
engineering_relevance: This offers a more sample-efficient RLVR training strategy that can reduce wasted rollouts while preserving stability as the policy changes.
method: Use a prior RL-optimized policy as an action-level experience prior.
Selectively inject experience at critical decision points during rollout.
Apply adapted importance sampling to keep learning stable and unbiased.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports consistent reasoning gains on five benchmarks using Qwen-2.5-math 7B and Qwen-3-8B compared with state-of-the-art RLVR methods.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality and compatibility of the prior policy, and the added importance-sampling mechanism may increase training complexity.
paper_title: Experience Augmented Policy Optimization for LLM Reasoning
